drug_class: Synthetic opioid analgesic with norepinephrine reuptake inhibition

avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Induces CYP2C9 and CYP2C19, reducing tapentadol plasma concentrations and efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; if necessary, monitor for reduced analgesia and adjust tapentadol dose

avoid_supplements.name: Valerian Root
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Potentiates CNS depression and increases risk of sedation, respiratory depression, and overdose
avoid_supplements.action: Contraindicated; counsel patient to avoid combination

avoid_supplements.name: Kava Kava
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Additive CNS depression and hepatotoxicity risk; may inhibit CYP2C9
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; monitor liver function if exposure occurs

caution_supplements.name: 5-HTP
caution_supplements.mechanism: Additive serotonergic effects; theoretical risk of serotonin syndrome given tapentadol's norepinephrine activity
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for agitation, confusion, rapid heart rate; counsel on risk

caution_supplements.name: Ginseng
caution_supplements.mechanism: Mild CYP2C9 induction possible; may slightly reduce tapentadol concentrations
caution_supplements.action: Monitor analgesic efficacy; adjust tapentadol if needed

caution_supplements.name: Melatonin
caution_supplements.action: Counsel on increased sedation risk; use lowest effective doses

avoid_foods.name: Alcohol
avoid_foods.mechanism: Severe potentiation of CNS depression, respiratory depression, sedation, and overdose risk; increased metabolism via shared pathways
avoid_foods.action: Absolute contraindication; counsel strict avoidance; educate on overdose risk

caution_foods.name: Grapefruit and Grapefruit Juice
caution_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition may modestly increase tapentadol concentrations; minor clinical significance given primary metabolism via CYP2C9/2C19
caution_foods.action: Monitor for increased side effects; counsel occasional use is likely safe

caution_foods.name: Tyramine-rich foods (aged cheeses, cured meats, fermented foods)
caution_foods.mechanism: Tapentadol's norepinephrine reuptake inhibition may potentiate tyramine effects; risk of hypertensive crisis is theoretical at typical doses
caution_foods.action: Counsel moderation; monitor blood pressure if high tyramine intake; clinical relevance is minimal

monitoring_notes: Monitor for CNS depression, respiratory depression, and serotonergic symptoms. Counsel patients to avoid alcohol absolutely and report excessive sedation, difficulty breathing, confusion, or mood/behavior changes. Assess baseline and periodic liver and renal function given glucuronidation pathway dependence.
